jobs.title: Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers
jobs.description:
**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**


The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high\-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.  

  

**Title:****Program Coordinator \- YAWL Young Adult Job Centers**

**Salary:****$30\.00 \- $34\.00 per hour plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Program Supervisor**

**Status:****Full\-Time, (40 hours/week), Non\-Exempt**  

  

**Program Summary:** CYC’s YAWL Workforce Development Program provides job readiness and employment support services to youth ages 16\-24\. The program offers 1:1 job search and career coaching, work based learning internships, college and career exploration, and job shadowing opportunities to propel youth and young adults to be ready for college, work and reach productive adulthood.  

  

**Position Description:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the Young Adult Job Center portfolio, supervising staff, overseeing workshops/trainings, establishing best practice program models, and providing high quality youth workforce and development services.  

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Young Adult Work Link program and comprehensive service delivery model.
* Develop policy and procedure recommendations to strengthen the program model and collaboration among grantee and coalition partners.
* Ensure program development and service delivery align with “Youth Program Quality Standards” and meet all “Work Plan” deliverables and deadlines.
* Complete all required documentation, reports, and program deliverables in a timely manner.
* Lead citywide outreach and recruitment efforts, cultivating strategic community partnerships and developing a robust referral network to support recruitment and engagement, with a focus on priority populations.
* Conduct participant assessments and provide intensive case management, wraparound supportive services, and guidance to address barriers affecting work and school performance.
* Develop individualized vocational goals and career plans using vocational and interest assessments, and provide personal and career guidance.
* Develop and facilitate job readiness training workshops, including but not limited to professionalism, career exploration, resume and cover letter building, job search/navigation, interview skill development, mock interviews, and strength/talent identification.
* Coordinate GED attainment, tutoring, basic skills remediation, postsecondary education, and workforce training services.
* Provide 1:1 career guidance and assist participants with individualized education and career planning services, job search and placement assistance and conduct follow ups for retention services.
* Connect participants to resources within CYC and other CBO or city services for barrier removal to ensure their success.
* Supervise, support, coach and train Program Specialists in job readiness training content, career counseling, outreach, funder databases, and other duties as applicable.
* Collaborate with the workforce team to strategize on program planning, development and implementation of overall youth workforce development programs and outcomes.
* Coordinate career exploration events and adult mentoring opportunities such as worksite/company tours, college tours, and networking events for program participants
* Cultivate relationships with employers, developing jobs for youth and young adults.
* Support agency\-wide events and perform other duties as assigned by management.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field.
* Experience working with diverse youth backgrounds, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Previous experience in program coordination and development.
* Ability to work with ethnically diverse groups of low\-income youth as well as English learners to support their social and emotional needs during transition.
* At least 1 year of experience supervising a team of three or more staff.
* Experience working with San Francisco's diverse communities and neighborhoods.
* Experience working with community\-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other technology platforms.
* Experience facilitating workshops for youth and young adults.
* Ability to work as part of a team, to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a high\-pressure environment.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin/Spanish and English is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college education.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs

  

CYC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, age, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other basis recognized by federal, state, or local law, including on the basis of the intersection of two or more protected characteristics, also known as intersectional discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Afterschool Programs
jobs.description:
Project Manager – Afterschool Programs

**CAM Educational Services (CAM Edu)**

**Pay:** $28\.00–$30\.00 per hour  
**Job Type:** Part\-Time  
**Work Location:** Millbrae, South San Francisco (SSF), and San Mateo, CA  
**Work Setting:** In Person

About CAM Educational Services

CAM Educational Services is an innovative educational organization providing high\-quality afterschool tutoring, childcare, and enrichment programs in partnership with schools and communities throughout California.

We are looking for an experienced, organized, and dependable **Project Manager – Afterschool Programs** to support the successful operation of our programs across **Millbrae, South San Francisco, and San Mateo**.

This is an excellent opportunity for an education professional, program coordinator, site supervisor, project manager, or experienced youth\-program leader who enjoys working with children, supporting staff, and building strong relationships with schools and communities.

About the Role

The Project Manager will oversee and support the day\-to\-day operations of assigned CAM Edu afterschool programs. This position requires strong leadership, communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills.

The Project Manager will work closely with instructors, site staff, school administrators, families, and CAM Edu leadership to ensure programs are properly staffed, organized, safe, engaging, and aligned with school and district expectations.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee daily operations of assigned afterschool programs.
* Coordinate and support instructors, childcare staff, tutors, and other program team members.
* Ensure assigned programs are adequately staffed and operational.
* Monitor staff attendance, punctuality, schedules, and classroom coverage.
* Assist with staff scheduling and make adjustments based on program needs.
* Conduct regular site visits to monitor program operations and quality.
* Communicate regularly with school administrators and CAM Edu leadership.
* Build and maintain positive relationships with school and district partners.
* Support staff onboarding, training, coaching, and professional development.
* Monitor classroom quality, student engagement, and classroom management.
* Ensure staff follow CAM Edu policies, procedures, and safety expectations.
* Address staff, student, parent, and school concerns professionally and promptly.
* Assist with incident reporting, attendance tracking, and required documentation.
* Monitor program supplies, classroom materials, equipment, and other resources.
* Ensure classrooms are safe, clean, organized, and prepared for daily programming.
* Support implementation of curriculum, enrichment activities, and program schedules.
* Track staffing needs, operational concerns, and follow\-up items.
* Provide regular updates and reports to CAM Edu management.
* Identify opportunities to improve program quality, efficiency, and staff performance.
* Assist with launching and supporting new school programs and initiatives.
* Perform additional duties and projects as assigned by management.

Leadership \& Staff Support

The Project Manager will serve as a key resource for program staff and will be expected to:

* Provide clear direction and expectations to staff.
* Support instructors with classroom\-management and student\-related concerns.
* Monitor employee attendance, performance, and professionalism.
* Identify staffing gaps and communicate coverage needs promptly.
* Provide coaching and constructive feedback.
* Help maintain a positive, respectful, and collaborative work environment.
* Escalate employee concerns to CAM Edu leadership when appropriate.

School \& Community Relations

* Maintain professional communication with school administrators, teachers, and district representatives.
* Respond to school requests and follow up on operational concerns.
* Represent CAM Edu professionally at assigned school sites.
* Build positive relationships with school staff, families, and community partners.
* Help ensure programs meet school and district expectations.
* Support CAM Edu's long\-term partnerships with schools and communities.

Qualifications

* Experience in education, afterschool programs, childcare, youth development, program coordination, or project management preferred.
* Previous leadership, supervisory, or program\-management experience strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting or managing teams of employees.
* Experience working with school\-age children and youth programs.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with CAM Edu leadership.
* Professional, dependable, flexible, and solution\-oriented attitude.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced educational environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Education, Business Administration, Management, Child Development, or a related field preferred but not required with relevant experience.

Work Expectations

* Part\-time position.
* Must be available to work in person at assigned school sites.
* Must be willing to support programs in **Millbrae, South San Francisco, and San Mateo**.
* Must be flexible with scheduling based on school and program needs.
* Must be available to travel between assigned sites when needed.
* Reliable transportation is strongly preferred.
* Must be responsive to time\-sensitive staffing and operational matters.
* Must be comfortable working with children, school personnel, families, and employees.
* Must maintain professionalism and confidentiality when handling student, employee, and school information.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is:

* Organized, dependable, and proactive.
* A strong and professional communicator.
* Comfortable leading and supporting staff.

jobs.title: HEALTH EDUCATION PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
The Health Education Program Coordinator manages and implements health education programs, develops community education and outreach activities, and counsels patients.




**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**




* Develops, implements, coordinates, and evaluates bilingual health education programs and activities on preventative health care, chronic disease management, Western medicine, and other related topics
* Develops curricula, toolkits, health education programs and materials
* Provides group class and/or one\-on\-one health education services to members and the general public
* Acts as primary liaison with appropriate community agencies and schools to establish, promote, and carry out community education and outreach programs
* Manages Health Education centers
* Counsels patients on a variety of subjects such as diabetes, hypertension, asthma, smoking cessation, substance abuse, teen health, Hepatitis B, preventive cancer screening and immunization, etc.
* Coordinates with clinical departments to develop multilingual educational material
* Reviews translations of materials for accuracy and appropriateness
* Researches grants and funding opportunities, and assists in writing grant proposals
* Collects, tabulates, analyzes program data, and prepares reports
* Works collaboratively with Administration and Project Management Department, and provides support in health information projects such as activity schedule, newsletter, informational displays, flyers posters, staff bulletin, community health events, etc.
* Travels to NEMS’ clinic site to conduct programs and events
* Supervises summer interns and volunteers and assists in implementing education activities for the Health Center Week
* Provides day\-to\-day operational support to Health Education Assistants including scheduling, training, and guidance; acts as a liaison to communicate updates or concerns to Health Education Manager as needed
* Supports walk\-ins and provider referrals to Health Education
* Administers Remote Patient Monitoring assignment, monitoring, tracking and calls
* Calls outreach lists tied to organizational goals and PIP measures, as needed
* Assists with ad hoc outreach lists (e.g., health plan initiatives or incentive programs that require patient outreach), as needed
* Covers and rotates to other sites as required
* Performs other job duties as required by manager/supervisor




**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree (degree in public health or related field preferred).
* Health \& Wellness Coach Training completed by a NBC\-HWC\-approved program or ability to obtain it within 6 months of first available training date is required
* CHES certification preferred
* Two years’ experience in community health education, health communication or related field preferred
* Prior experience in program planning, design and implementation that incorporates evidence\-based strategies and cultural competency
* Experience with formative research or program evaluation preferred
* Prior experience working with the underserved, immigrant, low\-income and/or Asian communities preferred
* Current documentation of Basic Life Support is required




**LANGUAGE:**




* Must be fluent in English (reading, writing, and speaking)
* Must be fluent in Chinese: Cantonese and/or Mandarin (reading, writing, and speaking)




**STATUS:**




This is an FLSA Non\-exempt position.


This is not an OSHA high\-risk position.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


Join Molecular Devices and help drive scientific discovery for life science customers in academia, biotech, pharma, and government. Our automated and AI\-enabled technology empowers researchers to tackle complex questions and gain deep insights, accelerating the development of safer, more effective therapeutics. As part of our team—rooted in collaboration, authenticity, and innovation—you’ll ultimately contribute to groundbreaking science that enhances lives globally and shapes a healthier future for all.


Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

As a leader within the sales organization, this role is responsible for building and maintaining a high performing technical sales team that can drive customer relationships directed toward growing Molecular Devices’ market share, revenue, and profitability year over year in the following target market segments: life sciences, government installations, biotechnology, pharma, academic research labs, contract labs, and incubator spaces.

* Bachelor’s Degree or higher in a related Life Sciences discipline.

jobs.description:
**About Vantage**
=================

  

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.


**Position Description:**

**This role will be based in Santa Clara California, following our flexible work policy (3 days in\-office and 2 days flexible).**

* Vantage is looking for an Assistant Project Manager to assist the Special Projects team and Project Managers to drive success on new and ongoing construction projects.
* The position covers all aspects of a construction project. Areas of expertise that require minimal oversight and autonomy in the following areas:
* RFP development and overall project budgeting
* Pre\-bid oversight and coordination assistance
* Assist managing all design phases and documents
* Assist managing, coordinating and supervising design\-build contractors and vendors
* Assist and/or coordinate with internal stakeholders and subject matter experts
* Assist with oversight of physical construction activities
* Participation in commissioning
* Assist, manage and own project close outs: Punch list, as\-builds, warranties, OEM, etc.
**Essential Job Functions:**

* Report to and assist Vantage Special Projects team and assigned manager.
* Proficient at taking initiative, problem solving, time management, and thinking outside the box.
* Gather vendor proposals, invoicing documents and ensure vendor deliverables are delivered in a timely manner.
* Manage individual tasks throughout the construction process including submittals, RFI process, drawings and safety reporting.
* Proficient understanding of contract types; i.e., GMP, Lump Sum, NTE, etc.
* Proficient understanding of invoicing; i.e., lien waivers, pay applications, retention, etc.
* Proficient in leading OAC meetings, coordination meetings, and facilitating stakeholder meetings.
* Coordinate VDC led meetings, manage meeting minutes and drive actions to closure.
* Oversee OFCI equipment release, delivery, deficiencies, startup and commissioning.
* Ensure project compliance, track construction progress via daily logs, site inspections and QA/QC.
* Manage project close\-out and documentation.
 **Duties:**

* Manage small to medium sized projects with Special Projects Project Manager or Sr. Project Manager oversight.
* Occasionally, based on Assistant Project Manager’s experience, readiness and learning development; individual may be included in larger more technical projects to assist Special Projects Project Manager or Sr. Project Manager.
* Assist and or manage multiple projects concurrently and projects in various locations.
* Coordinate internal alignment on project document reviews, budgeting and financial exercises and purchase order management.
* Enforce project quality controls and safety programs through an in\-depth understanding of the partner contracts and design docs.
* Manage and provide weekly HRA inspections to adhere to VDC safety metrics.
* Perform tasks accurately and execute with minimal supervision.
* Assist Vantage PM(s) in preparing monthly financial updates and forecasts.
* Manage contractor billing to ensure accuracy of scope included in each billing and timely review of all pay applications.
* Manage change orders and review process independently. Provide timely review of change orders with accuracy of scope and costs.
* Input PO requests in the financial system, track and manage distribution process to all Vantage vendors.
* Facilitate design page\-turns, document reviews, meeting minutes, capture deliverables and action items for internal stakeholders and direct contractor design partners.
* Manage Vantage vendor partners to ensure completion of their scope and overall project completion (i.e., Signage, furniture, AV, etc.)
* As required, manage design team/contractors throughout each project.
* Work closely with VDC Ops to coordinate ongoing site activities, develop and track MOPs and provide customer support as necessary.
* Manage, organize and maintain internal file storage.
* Own internal and external project closeout requirements.
* Assist and track as\-builds, permits, and coordinate with local authorities to ensure permits and documents are current.
* Time to time, additional duties may be assigned by management.
 **Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor of Science in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a similar field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 5\+ years’ experience as a Project Engineer in Construction Project Management assisting or supervising construction projects of increasing complexity is required.
* Data Center, Owner’s Representative and/or General Contractor experience is highly preferred.
* Experience in CSA (civil, structural, architectural) and MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) construction management is a requirement.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and project management tools like MS Project, P6, Procore and Bluebeam.
* Up to 10% travel may be required.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

jobs.description:
**What to Expect**
The Tesla AI Hardware Supply Chain team is seeking a Program Manager to support our next generation of AI\-focused platforms, with a primary emphasis on hardware for autonomous vehicles, humanoid robots, and AI servers. In this role, you will function as a key liaison between the Supply Chain organization and internal stakeholders, including Tesla’s Executive Team, Engineering, Sales, and Manufacturing. This position places significant weight on AI hardware integration, where you will collaborate closely with software developers to develop supply chain program automation tools. These tools will optimize sourcing strategies, new program introduction launch schedules and readiness, cost\-saving opportunities, and the full project lifecycle—from design concept and validation, to launch and mass production, through to excess, obsolescence, and service support. Program Managers will work hand\-in\-hand with Supply Chain Managers and Supplier Industrialization Engineers across all relevant commodities, applying advanced program/project management skills to ensure the timely and efficient execution of Tesla’s high\-impact AI hardware portfolio.

 **What You'll Do*** Represent the Supply Chain organization in meetings with Tesla’s Executive Team, providing updates on AI hardware program status, highlighting potential risks, and outlining proposed solutions and mitigation steps with a strong focus on hardware\-software integration
* Define, implement, and drive execution of project requirements, workflows, and plans, emphasizing automation tools co\-developed with software teams to streamline AI hardware supply chain processes
* Analyze the complete supply chain for AI hardware projects by defining and measuring performance criteria (e.g., milestone adherence for robot prototypes, sourcing progress for server GPUs, cost savings in vehicle autonomy modules, and operational efficiency) to support strategic decision\-making
* Manage project timelines and resources for AI hardware initiatives, ensuring risk mitigation actions are identified and in place to guarantee successful launches of autonomous vehicle systems, humanoid robot platforms, and AI server infrastructures
* Continuously monitor and measure project processes and activities to prevent delays, with proactive identification of risks in AI hardware sourcing, such as supply disruptions for specialized components in robotics or server farms
* Develop robust systems to track progress of critical manufacturing equipment readiness across our global supply chain, tailored to AI hardware needs like high\-precision assembly for humanoid joints or scalable production for AI servers
* Develop and maintain dashboards to track program status and communicate key AI hardware metrics to the broader organization, including Engineering, Finance, and Manufacturing
* Serve as the owner of RFQs and contract management—ensuring Non\-Disclosure Agreements, General Terms \& Conditions, Piece Price Agreements, and other contracts are negotiated, agreed upon, and documented before initiating business, with a focus on AI hardware IP protection
* Drive negotiations for piece price and product development to meet Tesla’s best\-landed\-cost expectations while upholding Supplier Industrialization standards for Best\-In\-Class quality in AI hardware components
* Collaborate closely with software developers to build and refine supply chain automation tools that cover the end\-to\-end project cycle: from initial design concepts and validation testing, to mass production scaling, and managing excess inventory, obsolescence planning, and long\-term service support for AI\-driven products
  

**What You'll Bring*** Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, or Operations Management, or equivalent experience
* At least 5 years of project/program management or strategic supply chain experience in a fast\-paced, highly fluid environment; strong preference for experience in manufacturing organizations, particularly with AI hardware, electronics, or automotive/robotics sectors
* Demonstrated, applied experience delivering complex programs and projects, ideally involving hardware\-software integration for autonomous systems, robotics, or data center infrastructure
* Superior analytical skills and the ability to use data and metrics to justify business decisions; knowledge of SQL (mySQL, Postgres, etc.) is a plus for developing automation dashboards
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and senior leadership on AI hardware initiatives
* Experience developing succinct, crisp executive summaries and presenting to leadership, with comfort discussing technical aspects of AI supply chains
* Exude executive presence and demonstrate ease presenting in front of Supply Chain leadership and Tesla’s Executive Team on behalf of the organization, particularly regarding high\-stakes AI projects
* Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment to achieve business objectives, including close partnerships with software development teams
* Demonstrated ability to establish business process issues and drive process improvements, such as automating supply chain workflows for AI hardware lifecycle management
* Open\-minded self\-starter with the ability to adapt, improvise, and problem\-solve in dynamic AI technology landscapes

* Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction

jobs.title: Clinical Safety Program Lead
jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life\-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Working at Abbott**


At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution

* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**The Opportunity**

The Clinical Safety Program Lead combines clinical study leadership, project management, and medical safety oversight to drive the successful execution of global clinical investigations. Serving as both the operational portfolio lead and study\-level safety expert, this role partners closely with Safety leadership and ensures studies are delivered efficiently while maintaining the highest standards of subject safety, scientific integrity, data quality, and regulatory compliance across the assigned portfolio. The individual is responsible for driving operational decisions, identifying gaps, developing solutions, and leading end\-to\-end data quality and safety processes. This individual anticipates and mitigates risks, proactively escalates and resolves issues, and drives execution against critical timelines in partnership with cross\-functional stakeholders. A key focus of the role is supporting ongoing priority studies while leading execution of upcoming IDE clinical investigations, ensuring consistent, inspection\-ready delivery and successful clinical development outcomes across the portfolio.


 The ideal candidate brings a unique blend of clinical research operations experience, project management expertise, and clinical or medical knowledge, enabling them to lead complex studies, evaluate safety data, influence cross\-functional decision\-making, and provide strategic guidance throughout the clinical development lifecycle. They are recognized as trusted a team member who can balance operational execution with safety oversight while fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous process improvement, in partnership with Safety leadership.

**What You’ll Work On**

* Lead the operational execution and safety oversight of global clinical studies from start\-up through study closeout.
* Serve as the primary safety lead for assigned portfolio, providing expert assessment of safety data, emerging trends, and potential risks.
* Support operational decision\-making by identifying gaps, developing solutions, and influencing cross\-functional teams.
* Develop and implement study\-specific safety management strategies and risk mitigation plans.
* Identify operational risks and implement mitigation strategies to maintain study timelines and quality standards and escalate risk to leadership.
* Lead end\-to\-end data review, data cleaning, and quality initiatives to ensure accurate, reliable, and inspection\-ready study data.
* Partner with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs, Biostatistics, Data Management, Quality, and Product Development to ensure successful study execution.
* Oversee external committees including Data Monitoring Committees and Clinical Events Committees.
* Drive protocol development, study design, endpoint definitions, and safety monitoring approaches across assigned portfolio.
* Ensure timely and compliant safety reporting to regulatory authorities, investigators, ethics committees, and internal stakeholders.
* Provide clinical interpretation of safety data and support regulatory submissions, clinical study reports, and health authority interactions.
* Drive inspection readiness, process improvements, and best practices across clinical operations and safety functions.
* Mentor team members and contribute to a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and patient focus.
* Anticipate study risks, proactively identify issues, and escalate critical concerns to ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain awareness of emerging clinical evidence, disease\-state developments, and competitive technologies.
* Establish and drive study timelines, deliverables, and action plans while holding teams accountable for execution.
* Contribute to development and revision of SOPs, work instructions, and best practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in nursing, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Public Health, or related field.
* 5\+ years of clinical research experience.
* Experience leading global clinical studies and cross\-functional teams.
* Experience in clinical safety, pharmacovigilance, medical monitoring, or safety surveillance.
* Experience in project management role or equivalent
* Strong knowledge of GCP, ISO 14155, FDA regulations, MDR, and global clinical research requirements.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced clinical degree (MD, PharmD, DNP, NP, PA\-C, MSN, PhD, or equivalent).
* Medical device, structural heart, vascular, or cardiac rhythm therapeutic area experience.
* Experience serving as a Medic

jobs.title: Client Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Nowadays**
==================


We're building the future of in\-person connection, from intimate exec offsites to a conference\-level company offsite.


Nowadays is the first AI\-powered platform for planning corporate events. Our software handles everything from venue sourcing to vendor negotiations, making it easier and faster for teams to meet up in real life.


We've planned events across the globe for companies like Google, Airbnb, and Quantstamp, and we're just getting started.


Our mission is simple: make it easier for teams to create meaningful moments together.

**Who we are**
==============


We're a sister\-founded team based in San Francisco. We move fast, care deeply, and love bringing people together (whether it's a strategic offsite or a Friendsgiving in our Nowadays home).


We believe the best teams:

* Take ownership
* Keep things scrappy
* Celebrate wins (big and small)
* Genuinely enjoy working (\+ hanging out) together


Some of our favorite team excursions so far:

* Flying trapeze
* Steak\-offs at home
* Hauling a Christmas tree up to the office
* Hitting the spa after a big launch
* Racing an Ironman Relay

**What this role is**
=====================


This is a **zero\-to\-one operations role**. You'll take messy, fast\-moving workflows and turn them into systems that are simple, teachable, and scalable, without losing the human care that defines Nowadays.

**What you'll do**
==================

**80% of your time will focus on event operations and client communication**

* Own events end\-to\-end simultaneously, including clear written \+ verbal on\-brand client communication
* Own and evolve the end\-to\-end ops flow for running events, from first request to post\-event wrap
* Be the point person for prioritizing urgent vs non\-urgent ops issues
* Turn tribal knowledge into clear documentation, onboarding, and templates that anyone can use

**The remaining 20% of your time will focus on building for scale**

* Build scalable playbooks for: running a single complex event start\-to\-finish, and managing many events in parallel
* Partner closely with engineering to: translate customer feedback and bugs into clear product requirements and actionable tickets, and help test, validate, and refine tools before launch
* Create and maintain internal resources: ops onboarding docs, and client\-facing guides and templates for planning offsites
* Continuously identify what should be simplified, automated, or eliminated

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* You consistently put clients first, understanding that this can sometimes require late nights or weekend work
* You can juggle multiple workstreams and know how to prioritize quickly
* You're excellent at turning complexity into clarity
* You care deeply about process, but never at the expense of momentum
* Extreme attention to detail
* You're comfortable working across ops, product, dev, sales, and clients
* You communicate clearly, thoughtfully, and with good judgment
* You like building systems that other people can run
* You want to shape how a company operates, not just follow a playbook

**Bonus points**
================

* Startup zero\-to\-one experience
* Experience working with clients \+ owning client relationships
* Strong intuition for customer experience and boundaries
* Experience writing clear tickets in tools like Linear or Jira
* Comfort with basic SQL or data analysis to answer operational questions
* Comfort using AI/tools to replace manual, repetitive work

**Other details**
=================

**Location**

* In\-person in San Francisco

**Perks**

* Free lunch \+ dinner
* Quarterly team offsites (yes, we went to the White Lotus S3 hotel in Thailand), and exclusive access to top venues and events
* Monthly fitness stipend
* Health insurance
* 12 weeks paid parental leave
* Generous PTO with required time off to recharge
* High ownership, autonomy, and direct access to founders
* Access to top venues, events, and travel experiences

  

Compensation Range: $90K \- $130K

jobs.title: IT Service Desk & SLA Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The IT Service Desk \& SLA Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end lifecycle of all IT support tickets, from initial intake through resolution and closure. This role demands unrelenting ownership: you will follow every ticket on its entire journey to the end\-of\-the\-earth to achieve resolution in a timely and effective manner.



Driven by a "Simple Sets You Free" mindset, this role actively strips away bureaucratic friction, eliminates operational waste, and continuously optimizes IT service management processes to maximize efficiency, speed up ticket resolution, and boost customer satisfaction.



### **In This Role, You Will...**


End\-to\-End Ticket Ownership \& Lifecycle Management
* Relentless Resolution Ownership: Personally track and follow tickets on their entire journey to the end\-of\-the\-earth, taking total responsibility until issues are thoroughly, accurately, and effectively resolved.

Queue Administration \& Triage: Monitor, triage, and assign incoming incidents, service requests, and problem tickets across multi\-tiered support teams with speed and accuracy.* Closure \& Quality Control: Validate that all tickets are properly documented, root causes are identified, and end\-users confirm resolution before ticket closure.
* Escalation Management: Identify aging, stuck, or high\-priority (P1/P2\) tickets and proactively cross organizational boundaries to drive action and prevent SLA breaches.


Process Optimization \& Friction Elimination ("Simple Sets You Free")
* Bottleneck Identification: Continuously audit ticket lifecycles, intake workflows, and escalation paths to pinpoint bottlenecks, redundant approvals, or process inefficiencies that delay issue reporting and resolution.
* Streamlined Workflows: Design and implement intuitive, simplified ticketing processes and self\-service channels that make it effortless for users to report issues and for technicians to resolve them.
* Root\-Cause Process Fixing: Collaborate across IT and business departments to re\-engineer flawed processes, remove unnecessary handoffs, and eliminate administrative bloat slowing down resolution times.
* Automation \& Lean Operations: Champion lean service desk practices by eliminating obsolete procedures, automating routine tasks, and establishing straightforward, zero\-friction standards across all support tiers.


SLA \& Metric Tracking
* SLA Monitoring: Enforce and monitor compliance against core SLAs (First Response Time, Mean Time to Resolution \[MTTR], First Contact Resolution \[FCR], and Customer Satisfaction \[CSAT]).
* Reporting \& Dashboards: Design, build, and maintain real\-time operational dashboards and weekly/monthly executive report packs using ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Zendesk).
* Trend Analysis: Analyze incident data to detect recurring technical issues, capacity bottlenecks, or process failures, feeding insights directly into Problem Management.


Process Governance \& Continuous Improvement
* ITIL \& Lean Governance: Standardize and enforce streamlined incident management processes, simplified escalation pathways, and consistent ticket categorization/tagging.
* Vendor \& Cross\-Team Coordination: Hold internal technical teams and external IT vendors accountable to contractual response and resolution targets while streamlining joint operational workflows.
* Customer Feedback: Manage the CSAT survey process, follow up on negative feedback, and implement actionable improvement plans based on direct user input.


### **Qualifications**

* 3–5\+ years in IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations, or Service Desk leadership roles with demonstrated experience in end\-to\-end ticket management and lean process optimization.
* Unwavering ownership mentality—willing to follow a ticket to the end\-of\-the\-earth to see it resolved.
* Strong lean operational mindset focused on process simplification and waste reduction.
* Advanced proficiency in ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Jira Service Desk, BMC Helix, Freshservice, etc.).
* Deep expertise in analytics/BI platforms (Power BI, Tableau, Excel/Google Sheets advanced reporting).

### **Bonus Qualifications**

* ITIL v3/v4 Foundation certification
* Excellent written/verbal communication
* Strong analytical problem\-solving
* Proven ability to simplify complex technical workflows under tight SLA timelines

**Base Salary Range**

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.
**About Zoox**
Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. **Space Readiness:** Maintain a world\-class, organized, and safety\-compliant lab space ready for daily engineering and research use.
  
  

**Workshop Operations:** Work in our workshop, ensure the space is organised, safe and is working to enable our research.
  
  

**Strategic Improvements:** Identify bottlenecks in deployment or lab workflows and develop strategies to improve efficiency, safety, and uptime.
  
  

**Global Alignment:** Aligning with our other sites across the US, ensuring no misalignment of the technical data.

Operations experience working as a (or with) hardware engineers in a robotics deployment environment.
  
  

Proven experience in a start\-up or faced paced R\&D environment.
  
  

Program management experience across operations.
  
  

Workshop management \& H\&S experience
  
  

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a keen eye for detail.
  
  

Proficiency in the Google Suite (docs, sheets)

**GFT** is seeking an experienced, hourly **Sr. Project Manager** to join our Construction Services team.  

At **GFT**, we’re not just engineering the future; we’re meticulously building it. Our comprehensive suite of construction and program management services reflects our unwavering commitment to excellence, safety, innovation, and sustainability. Our construction management services are the cornerstone of our commitment to transforming communities and enhancing lives. jobs.title: Project Manager, Consumer Products – Maternal Care
jobs.description:
Willow is a platform for products that help improve the lives and health of women. We are a mission\-driven team of experienced inventors, mothers, and fathers dedicated to making a difference in women's lives. The Willow™ Wearable Breast Pump, selected as one of TIME's 25 Best Inventions in 2017 and 2018 CES Innovation Award for Wearable Technologies, is the first solution in our platform.

### **Job Overview:**



Willow is seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead new product development for our consumer maternal care product line. This role requires collaboration and coordination across industrial design, engineering, marketing, supply chain, and customer experience to bring products to moms that fit the reality of their lives. The Program Manager will bring together technical and business resources, drive requirements gathering and feasibility, and execute programs from concept through retail and DTC launch.


### **What you'll do:**


* Manage complex cross\-functional consumer product programs, driving new product development, packaging, and sustaining initiatives from concept to launch.
* Collaborate with industrial design, engineering, marketing, and supply chain to define product requirements, set priorities, and establish scope, budget, and timelines.
* Be a force\-multiplier for functional leads to resolve issues, by identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks, and proactively removing obstacles.
* Partner with marketing and customer insights teams to incorporate voice\-of\-customer feedback from moms throughout the development process.
* Coordinate packaging, retail, and DTC launch readiness activities, including go\-to\-market timelines and cross\-functional launch reviews.
* Develop recommendations, gain alignment, and proactively facilitate decision making across engineering, marketing, and operations stakeholders.
* Manage supplier and contract manufacturer relationships in partnership with supply chain to ensure on\-time, on\-quality delivery.

### **What you'll bring:**


* 6\+ years of experience, with 3\+ years of project or program management in consumer products or consumer electronics.
* Bachelor's degree or higher preferred, or equivalent experience.
* Experience bringing consumer hardware or CPG products through the full lifecycle, from concept to retail/DTC launch and sustaining.
* Experience partnering with marketing, industrial design, and supply chain teams to launch products on time and on budget.
* Familiarity with the maternal health, baby, or wellness product category is a plus.
* Experience using Atlassian tools such as JIRA \& Confluence for project management, analysis, and reporting.
* An ability to communicate technical problems and solutions clearly to diverse audiences at all levels of the organization.
* A strong sense of ownership, urgency, and drive.
* An agile project management style, approach, and execution.
* Strong familiarity with project management software tools (e.g. SmartSheet, JIRA/Atlassian), methodologies, and best practices.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or Program Management Professional (PgMP) certification preferred.


Willow is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability, or Veteran status.

Willow is seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead new product introduction (NPI) for our connected medical devices. This role requires close collaboration with hardware, firmware, software, regulatory/quality, clinical, and manufacturing teams to bring safe, reliable, and connected products to market. The Program Manager will drive requirements gathering, design controls, and technical feasibility, and will execute cross\-functional plans to hit key program milestones from concept through launch and sustaining.


### **What you'll do:**


* Manage complex cross\-functional NPI programs for connected medical devices, from concept through design, verification and validation, transfer to manufacturing, and sustaining.
* Collaborate with hardware, firmware, mobile/app, regulatory, quality, and clinical teams to define requirements, set priorities, and establish scope, budget, and timelines.

### **What you'll bring:**


* 12\+ years of experience, with 5\+ years of program or project management in medical devices or another regulated hardware/software industry.

* Experience leading NPI programs for connected or electro\-mechanical medical devices through the full lifecycle, from concept to launch and sustaining.
* Working knowledge of FDA QSR (21 CFR Part 820\), ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and ISO 14971, and experience partnering with regulatory/quality teams to meet design control requirements.
* Experience coordinating hardware, firmware, and connected software/app workstreams within a single program.
* Experience using Atlassian tools such as JIRA \& Confluence for project management, analysis, and reporting.

Willow is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability, or Veteran status.

### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position:**


Intuitive’s Digital organization aims to improve patient care and empower care teams with unique data and insights from our integrated digital ecosystem. Program Managers in Digital are responsible for delivering new products and sustaining existing capabilities to our customers and partners.


Program Managers in Digital are responsible for delivering new products. We’re looking for people with proven track records of delivering complex, integrated, cross\-functional products with high standards of quality. Digital program managers are engaged in all aspects of the product lifecycle from requirements analysis and architectural design to software engineering development, QA, deployment, and market rollout. Our program managers align hardware and software engineering, clinical and regulatory schedules, and ensure that the right products are created at the right time, with low drama.


At Intuitive, Program Management is not a task\-based job. We are responsible for successful outcomes and delivery. This means that while strong program management fundamentals are a must, the role requires an understanding of product development and manufacturing, and, most importantly, managing through influence.


We look for candidates who know what success looks like and feel a personal stake in the services they support and the people they manage. People who understand how medical technology products are developed. People with a deep well of positive energy and unbounded enthusiasm. We look for people who hold themselves and their program teams to (almost, but not quite) impossibly high standards. People with unshakeable integrity and deep wisdom \& judgment. People who need to know why. People who are comfortable in ambiguity and excel at bringing order to it. People who strive to simplify and to clarify. People who are as comfortable presenting to execs as they are with their nose buried in a burndown chart.


**Roles and Responsibilities:**


* Effectively manage cross\-functional development programs across Intuitive’s different Business units and shared services, overseeing critical projects, and delivering against commitments.
* Help teams prioritize tasks to focus on the critical activities that drive progress and avoid being sidetracked by less important issues.
* Collaborate with the cross\-functional teams to ensure the right people are updated with the right information at the right time on status and ensure that cross\-product dependencies are understood, planned for, and crisply executed
* Perform risk analysis, develop contingency plans, and gather data from functions to proactively raise prioritization and scheduling tradeoff decisions
* Drive required discipline and rigor in requirements analysis, design, development, and testing through good development practices and effective use of phase gates.
* Work across the organization and external partners as needed to align functional support and input for the project
* Contribute to and help lead improvement Intuitive project management processes and ongoing improvements to the way we ship new products and capabilities.
* Function as a primary point\-of\-contact for stakeholders across the org.

### **Qualifications**


**Required Skills and Experience**


* Demonstrated history of leadership in project, program, and portfolio management of software delivery programs, at scale.
* Demonstrated excellence in program management capabilities across product lifecycle, from ideation through commercialization.
* Strong grasp of software product development engineering principles, manufacturing, servicing, and quality control.
* Understanding of Design Controls under US and International Regulations
* Proven ability to think strategically, plan and align product development with business goals and market needs.
* Naturally accountable and responsible; self\-starter, self\-motivated, self\-directed, self\-sufficient.
* Outstanding communication and presentation skills, written and verbal, to all levels of an organization.
* Experience with development and commercialization of medical technology.
* Ability to recognize project challenges and drive creative and simple solutions with a customer\-focused approach
* Proven ability to influence at various levels and drive conflict resolution with low drama

**Required Education and Training**


* At least 8 years of program \& project management experience with a bachelor’s degree and 6 years with a Master’s degree. This must include hands\-on experience with development and commercialization of highly technical medical devices.
* Understanding of Design Controls under US and International Regulations preferred.
* Certification in project management (PMP, CSM) desired

* Guide teams and participate with research and prepare documentation for required permits, right of ways, easements, and land use for telecom projects.

* Monitor projects to improve the quality of the work and to reduce the time and cost of project throughput.

* Implement corrective actions, as appropriate, on any project to meet cost targets, and completion schedules.
* Ensures subordinates’ abilities are adequate for their responsibilities and develops training and cross training for ongoing skill development.
* Assist personnel with interpreting customer drawings, project documentation, and technical specifications.

* Perform other related duties as assigned by their supervisor.

 **Qualifications**

* 5\+ years’ experience in permitting design, government affairs or related work in a Utility / Permitting environment in a related industry preferred.
* 5\+ years of Project Management experience in utility permitting or related field preferred.
* In\-depth understanding of NESC 202X code requirements preferred.
* Regulatory Compliance Expertise: Advanced understanding of local, state, and federal regulations related to underground utilities, coupled with the ability to effectively incorporate these regulations into permit drawings,
* Advanced understanding of Telecom OSP Engineering and Construction standards to apply design standards to underground and aerial pole line cable plant, including Joint Use Design, Pole Replacement, Primary Service, and Reliability/Maintenance Design.
* Proven leadership of a Make Ready Team to Perform structural loading calculations using O\-Calc or Spida\-Calc in accordance with NESC and pole owner protocol through inventory and analysis of pole type and class, riser details, attached facility type including weight and diameters, span footages, drip loops etc.
* Ability to create 3\-dimensional model of poles in O\-Calc and Spida\-Calc to provide results to ensure safe and proper attachment to power and telecommunication poles.
* Analytical and observational skills, which demonstrate ability to, plan projects, review/recommend technical specifications, coordinate staffing needs, communicate, and manage all aspects of a project.

* Effectively work independently and in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment is essential.

**Application Opening:** Wednesday, September 9, 2026  

**Application Deadline:** Apply immediately. Application filing will be open at least through 11:59pm (PST) of Wednesday, September 16, 2026, and will close any time thereafter.  

**Salary Range:** $228,124 \- $245,570 Annually ($109\.67 \- $118\.06 hourly)  

**Recruitment ID:** PEX\-5504\-164763; RTF0164762\-01121906

**Appointment Type:** Permanent\-Exempt (PEX), Category 18\. This position is excluded by the Charter from the competitive Civil Service examination process and shall serve at the discretion of the Appointing Officer and shall not exceed 36 months


Becoming a City employee means being a part of a team that cares about making a difference. Your work will shape both the present and future of San Francisco. When you work for the City, you’re choosing a job with purpose.


San Francisco Public Works (Public Works) has a far\-reaching portfolio with a $453 million annual operating budget, an active capital portfolio that exceeds $3 billion and a workforce of 1,700\-plus employees. The department operates around the clock, touching every neighborhood in San Francisco. The staff designs and manages the construction of civic buildings and streets; cleans and greens the right of way; maintains civic buildings; manages multi\-million\-dollar bond programs; trains people for jobs; keeps the right of way free of hazards; paves the roads; repairs bridges and public stairways; expands accessibility; and works at the forefront addressing some of San Francisco’s biggest challenges. With a mission to enhance the quality of life in San Francisco for residents, visitors and business owners, Public Works is committed to providing outstanding public service through an equity lens.


Please visit the “About Us” section of our website at https://www.sfpublicworks.org to learn more about the department’s core values, Racial Equity Initiative, leadership team, history, budget and more.


Public Works currently has 2 vacancies for a Project Manager II (5504\) within the Project Delivery Division.

 **Job Description** **Role Description:**


The San Francisco Public Works streetscape portfolio encompasses a number of major projects including the Bayview Multimodal Improvement Projects, the 11th Street Safety Project and other projects totaling over $121 million, with active planning, design, construction, or financial closeout phases extending through 2030\. These projects involve transforming high\-volume corridors through multi\-modal safety enhancements, protected bike lanes, and extensive utility and public realm upgrades while coordinating closely with merchants and local community benefit districts to mitigate event impacts. These projects involve working with design elements that involve deep partnership with community leaders and cultural stakeholders. Together, these citywide efforts backed by interagency collaboration with partners such as the SFMTA, San Francisco Planning, and the SFPUC aim to modernize San Francisco's corridors, elevate pedestrian safety, and celebrate neighborhood identity.

**Important and Essential Duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Directing and overseeing a portfolio of major streetscape, transit, and public realm capital projects through active phases of planning, design, construction, and financial closeout.
* Providing technical oversight, performance guidance, and mentorship to subordinate project managers overseeing portfolios valued at up to $66 million.
* Coordinating the implementation of large\-scale multi\-modal safety enhancements, roadway reconstructions, utility and sewer upgrades, traffic signals, green infrastructure, and public realm improvements.
* Engaging with neighborhood organizations, stakeholders, and business districts to preserve historical character\-defining features and address community concerns during project execution.
* Coordinating complex construction sequencing around major public venues, commercial activities, and high\-traffic events to minimize disruption to the community.
* Leading interagency and cross\-departmental collaboration by partnering with municipal planning, transportation, utilities, arts, and recreation agencies to secure approvals, align public realm plans, and ensure cohesive design standards across the city.

  

**Qualifications** **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**


1\. a) Bachelor's Degree in architecture, engineering or planning; **and**  

 b) Four (4\) years of responsible professional experience in architectural, engineering or construction management experience; **and**  

 c) Two (2\) years of additional project coordination experience;

**OR**


2\. a) Bachelor's Degree in another field; **and**  

 b) Six (6\) years of responsible professional experience in a field directly related to the project; **and**  

 c) Two (2\) years of additional project coordination experience;  

  

**OR**


3\. a) Eight (8\) years of architectural, engineering, or construction management experience in a field directly related to the project; **and**  

 b) Two (2\) years of additional project coordination experience;  

  

**OR**


4\. a) California registration as professional engineer or architect; **and**  

 b) Two (2\) years of additional project coordination experience

**Note:**  

One (1\) year of full\-time employment is considered equivalent to Two Thousand (2,000\) hours. Any overtime hours that you work above forty (40\) hours per week are not included in the calculation to determine full\-time employment.

**Verification:**  

Applicants may be required to submit verification of qualifying education and experience at any point during the recruitment and selection process. More information can be found at: https://sfdhr.org/recruitment\-details\#verification.

jobs.description:
**Who we are**



Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.



Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**



Our Senior Web Program Manager is a strategic role responsible for overseeing multiple interconnected web projects and driving complex digital initiatives that align with organizational objectives. It combines advanced program management expertise with strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and team leadership to deliver high\-impact programs — bringing structure, streamlined processes, and best practices to our digital organization.



The ideal candidate has previous experience working in a digital agency and/or internal digital department where high\-quality results are required.



This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US, with working hours in the Pacific time zone and the ability to collaborate with colleagues across a variety of time zones.


**You Should Apply If:**


* You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real\-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper\-growth environment.
* You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
* You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high\-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

**In this role, you will:**


*Program \& Project Management*


* Own all phases of complex, cross\-functional digital programs — from inbound ticket management, to planning through delivery — with a clear understanding of vision, scope, objectives, timelines, business value, and resource requirements.
* Develop holistic program plans comprised of multiple project plan documents, including business requirements, technical specifications, schedules, funding, and resource plans.
* Track milestones, tasks, and deliverables; provide timely status updates to stakeholders and senior executives; and proactively identify and mitigate risks and dependencies.
* Lead process improvement initiatives to increase efficiency and delivery quality.

*Stakeholder \& Executive Communication*


* Serve as the strategic bridge between vision and tactical execution, translating high\-level business objectives into actionable program roadmaps.
* Interface with executives and senior leadership to align on priorities, communicate timelines and approval frameworks, and present program progress and website demonstrations.
* Facilitate team discussions, resolve conflict, and remove impediments that block the team's ability to meet project objectives.

*Cross\-Functional Collaboration*


* Orchestrate the efforts of cross\-functional teams — including Creative, IT, PMM, Campaigns, and front\-end development — to execute strategic launches, awareness campaigns, website updates, and other digital initiatives.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to define desired website functionality and appearance; lead the development team through product development stages and into live deployment.
* Work effectively with external agency providers, consultants, and contractors as needed.

*Process \& Documentation*


* Document website development processes and procedures; establish and scale best practices across the digital program.
* Introduce mitigation tactics to minimize project delivery risks and drive continuous improvement across programs.

**Minimum Requirements**


* 7\+ years of project management experience at a digital agency and/or internal digital department with a primary focus on digital
* Proficiency with project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Airtable, Jira, Google Sheets) and experience with Google Suite, Salesforce, and Tableau
* Experience integrating AI tools into program management processes to increase efficiency
* Strong understanding of the digital production process, timelines, and scoping requirements
* Experience launching digital solutions, including ongoing analysis and continuous product improvements
* Working knowledge of the technical software development process and Agile delivery methods, including Scrum and/or Kanban
* Outstanding organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills — written, verbal, and presentation
* Ability to work effectively with agency providers, consultants, contractors, and other external suppliers
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving obstacles and risks in partnership with teams and stakeholders

**Total Rewards**

We're hiring a Senior Stucco Estimator/Project Manager to prepare accurate, competitive bids for commercial and multi\-family lath, plaster, EIFS, and scaffold projects across California and Nevada. * 

**What You Bring**


* 8\+ years of commercial construction estimating experience, with lath, plaster, EIFS, scaffold, or closely related exterior\-finish/Division 09 trades strongly preferred
* Strong ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, and detail drawings
* Proficiency with estimating/takeoff software such as Bluebeam
* Working knowledge of Sage construction accounting/estimating modules a plus
* Strong understanding of California construction practices; Nevada experience a plus given cross\-state project coverage
* Ability to manage multiple active bids and deadlines simultaneously
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for working with project managers, superintendents, vendors, and general contractors


**Nice to Have**


* Experience estimating public works / prevailing wage projects
* Existing relationships with lath, plaster, and exterior\-finish material suppliers in the Sacramento/Reno markets

jobs.title: Senior Product Quality Manager
jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.


Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.


We are seeking a Senior Product Quality Manager to join our Supply Chain team in San Francisco, California. This role sits at the intersection of Oura Manufacturing, R\&D, and Supply Chain, partnering closely with design, process engineering, operations, and contract manufacturers (CMs) to drive the successful development and ramp of New Product Introduction (NPI) programs.


You will champion product quality and the user experience by ensuring every ring meets Oura’s rigorous standards for health accuracy, reliability, and jewelry\-like craftsmanship. You will establish and improve quality systems at CMs, ensuring robust data collection and analysis to support critical program decisions and long\-term supply chain improvements.


From concept through high\-volume production, you will develop and implement measurement methods, control plans, and quality processes that ensure components and assemblies are manufacturable, scalable, and consistently meet product requirements. You will serve as a key liaison between Oura and our manufacturing partners, fostering a strong culture of quality across the supply chain.


Working closely with Operations and Program Management, you will plan and execute NPI builds while continuously influencing both product and process development. Success in this role requires a strong understanding of manufacturing processes, Design for Manufacturing (DFM), and the ability to translate quality requirements into scalable manufacturing solutions.


**This is a US Hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with an in\-office requirement of three days per week, and will require significant travel to Finland and Asia.**


### **What You Will Do:**


* Support New Product Introduction (NPI) through FATP development builds, ramp\-up, and product launch / mass production
* Serve as the bridge between Design, Engineering, and Operations, translating complex technical risks into actionable business decisions to drive Oura’s quality initiatives
* Analyze build failure data to identify design and process marginalities, ensuring that yield loss is understood from a quality risk perspective, not just a volume perspective
* Lead build readiness reviews, focusing on quality deliverables such as equipment readiness, process qualification, and post\-build quality data analysis to understand system level interactions and assembly tolerance stackups that drive design and process improvements
* Establish and enforce the standard for “premium” quality by defining cosmetic specifications, managing golden/limit samples, and aligning design, engineering, and factory teams on subjective criteria (fit, finish, and feel) early in the NPI process.
* Identify and effectively communicate design and process risks, using data\-driven approaches to facilitate discussions and improvements across Oura teams and suppliers
* Analyze and evaluate data to establish appropriate sub\-assembly / system level spec limits including cosmetic, dimensional, functional/reliability as well as establish process controls limits
* Validate that CM processes produce units that meet cosmetic, reliability, and functional design intent.
* You are a technical leader who refuses to compromise on the user experience. You understand that “shippable” isn't just about passing a functional test, but about meeting the high aesthetic and reliability standards our customers expect.

### **What you'll bring**


* 7\+ years of experience working in a Product Quality, Supplier Manufacturing, Manufacturing Quality Engineer, or Process Engineer role. Ideally seeking someone with strong mechanical process development and design understanding
* Experience in System Integration environments (FATP), bringing together mechanical enclosures and electronics into a final finished product.
* Experience with quality engineering in high volume hand held / wearable and/or consumer products manufacturing with high cosmetic standards
* Experience qualifying and auditing manufacturing processes including PSA/HAF attach, epoxy dispense/molding/curing, and solder/hotbar/laser weld
* Experience developing robust IQC / IPQC / OQC controls, including AOI \& cosmetics, sampling plans, qualification criteria, SOP/MSOP, CQA, OBA, and dimensional control
* Understanding of quality principles and tools such as GRR, CRR, SPC, FA/CA, FMEA, and DOEs.
* Understanding of manufacturing/design principles and tools such as DFM, GD\&T, and Six Sigma methodologies for variability reduction
* A self\-driven mindset, and are an eager problem solver who thrives in demanding quick\-paced environments
* High organizational skills with the ability to clearly and succinctly communicate complex concepts through presentations and written communication, such as slide decks and email
* Ability to set up systems to capture reliable and meaningful data to help drive critical process improvements and enhance product/component design
* Willingness and eagerness to travel internationally up to 50%

### **Benefits**


At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.


What we offer:


* Competitive salary and equity packages
* Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
* An Ōura Ring of your own
