jobs.description:
Cytokinetics is a specialty cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, building on its over 25 years of pioneering scientific innovations in muscle biology, and advancing a pipeline of potential new medicines for patients suffering from diseases of cardiac muscle dysfunction.


The Drug Safety Case Manager will support the day\-to\-day functioning of the Drug Safety Department. The candidate will have a key a role in development, implementation, and maintenance of a quality system for all Drug Safety activities, encompassing processes, procedures, compliance, and metrics.


**Responsibilities**

* Ensures that all safety reports received from any source for Cytokinetics’ products are processed in the safety database and reported according to ICH\-GCP guidelines, regulatory requirements and company SOPs, Work Instructions, departmental procedures and business partner agreements
* Assists in overseeing the CRO processing SAE reports on Cytokinetics products in accordance with all applicable regulations, guidelines, and SOPs. This includes detailed review of source documentation, assessing cases for reportability, generation of analysis of similar events, quality check.
* Processes adverse event related information in drug safety database for Cytokinetics’ products, including the writing of narratives for expedited and non\-expedited reports.
* Coordinates follow up for missing or ambiguous safety data.
* Coordinates the production of safety data outputs from the Safety database for analyses and reports.
* Maintains regulatory and department compliance by ensuring timely completion of reports and assisting in submissions of reportable cases to regulatory agencies, study investigators, and licensing partners, as needed.
* Participates is Study Operation Team meetings for assigned studies and leads the PV\-related study activities including preparation of study start\-up activities (e.g., development of study\-specific Safety Management Plans, training of internal /external project\-team members in safety\-reporting processes, development of safety report forms, safety data reconciliation, site initiation training activities)
* Liaises with other functional groups for implementation of PV\-related processes requiring cross functional collaboration, such as SAE data reconciliation between Clinical and Safety databases.
* Evaluates project or case workflow and offers solutions for process improvement.
* May represent the Drug Safety Department in cross\-functional team meetings.
* Conducts periodic reconciliation of SAEs between the drug safety and clinical trial databases for ongoing clinical studies.
* Drafts and updates departmental SOPs and other work practices as assigned and maintains consistency with regulatory guidelines and good pharmacovigilance practices.
* Participates in training internal and external audiences on drug safety\-related topics, as assigned.
* Maintains a high level of understanding of federal and international regulations and guidance so as to guide departmental policies and procedures.
* Assists with the preparation of periodic safety reports as assigned
* Assists with preparation of safety data presentations for departmental meetings (e.g., Drug Safety Committee Meetings)
* Assists with the mentoring, training and support for departmental team members for high quality and consistent execution of daily activities in the Drug Safety Department
* Acts as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for safety related activities
* Participates in the creation of the department strategy, goals, and objectives, and assists in the implementation of new safety initiatives and new Health Authority safety requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in life sciences. Health care professional (pharmacy, nursing or equivalent) is strongly preferred
* 3 to 5 years of experience in drug safety with broad exposure to various PV\-related activities including ICSR activities and periodic reports.
* Broad knowledge of domestic and international drug safety regulations, industry practices and standards.
* Experience with drug safety databases (e.g., Argus, ARISg)
* Excellent working knowledge of MedDRA and WHODRUG coding dictionaries
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively, collaboratively under minimal supervision with a sense of urgency in a dynamic, cross\-function matrix environment
* Proficiency in the use of relevant computer systems including MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
* Strong interpersonal, written and oral communication skills and professionalism
* Strong organizational skills, detail oriented and adapts in a dynamic, fast\-paced, environment.

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Infrastructure Supply Chain and Manufacturing Operations Group (ISM) aims to establish Google as the undisputed leader in AI/ML infrastructure by building the highest performance, most cost\-effective, and most reliable AI/ML infrastructure on the planet. The team has end to end accountability for ingesting demand signals from the product area and then outputting TPU, GPU, Compute, Storage and machines. We are responsible for supplier technology evaluation and selection, strategic investments, sourcing negotiations and commercial agreements, supply operations and assurance, silicon quality assurance and Global Manufacturing operations.  

  

As a Supply Chain Program Manager, you will drive the operational excellence and strategic planning for material flow supporting Google’s critical technical infrastructure supply chain. You will be instrumental in ensuring the right materials are in the right place at the right time to meet complex, global production demands. This role requires a blend of supply and demand tracking, deep analytical excellence, and process optimization through dashboard automation.


Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Track supply delivery schedules, identifying and mitigating supply risks (e.g., component shortages, lead time changes).
* Create supply/demand models with what\-if scenario analysis capabilities for our technical infrastructure server and intra\-DC networking component deliveries.
* Drive key processes to align material supply with demand forecasts at a component level.
* Design, build, and maintain automated data pipelines and interactive dashboards (e.g., in dashboards or similar BI tools) to provide real\-time, actionable insights into material availability, consumption rates, and risk exposure.
* Utilize advanced analytics (SQL, Python) to model supply scenarios, analyze cost\-to\-serve, and identify opportunities for optimization.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



Join Anthropic as a Customer Success Manager supporting our Beneficial Deployments team's initiatives in Life Sciences. As a Customer Success Manager for Life Sciences, you’ll be a strategic partner and trusted advisor to the world's leading organizations working to accelerate scientific discovery. You will help them harness the full potential of Claude's capabilities across the API, Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and Claude Science to accelerate their scientific work.



This is a hybrid role that blends deep 1:1 account management with scaled, one\-to\-many programs. You'll own a portfolio of named strategic accounts, such as research institutes, academic medical centers, scientific foundations, and mission\-driven biotech, where you'll build genuine partnerships grounded in a deep understanding of their research mission, scientific objectives, programmatic goals, and technical capacity. * Develop and execute change management strategies appropriate for scientific and academic organizational cultures, driving adoption through Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement that respects partner capacity constraints, governance requirements, and decision\-making processes

* Guide partners through the technical and governance foundation for launch, including SSO and provisioning, workspace configuration, and data handling considerations relevant to research and health data (such as HIPAA, IRB, and institutional data policies), so research and IT leaders trust the deployment from day one
* Document and quantify value realized through research productivity, time\-to\-insight, program effectiveness, cost savings, and mission amplification to build compelling cases for continued investment in AI, and partner with Marketing to develop success stories and reference accounts

**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------


* 6\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Solutions Engineering
* 3\+ years of experience in life sciences research with ample exposure to the intersection of new technologies as a catalyst for accelerating progress
* Experience working directly with life sciences organizations, such as academic research institutions, nonprofit research institutes, foundations, biotech, or pharma, and familiarity with how scientific research is conducted, funded, and governed.
* Deep understanding of regulations, risk, and compliance needs of the industry
* Experience driving success across both consumption\-based and seat\-based business models, with understanding of different expansion levers and success metrics for each
* Experience designing and delivering one\-to\-many customer programs (webinars, hackathons, cohort\-based onboarding, user communities, or similar) alongside managing dedicated strategic accounts

jobs.title: Sr. Cloud Technical Account Manager, ES - NAMER - US-SUP
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support, Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient.
  

  

The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.  

  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

Key job responsibilities  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

  

A day in the life  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.  

  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS  

  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth  

  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of design/implementation/operations/consulting with distributed applications experience
* 5\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Math, or related

Cogent Communications is a multinational, Tier 1 facilities\-based ISP, consistently ranked as one of the top five networks in the world and is publicly traded on the NASDAQ Stock Market under the ticker symbol CCOI. Cogent's facilities\-based, all\-optical IP network backbone provides IP services in over 228 markets globally. This network enables Cogent to offer large bandwidth connections at highly competitive prices. Cogent also offers superior customer support by virtue of its end\-to\-end control of service delivery and network monitoring. Structured tenure pay increases and an uncapped commissions plan offers you unlimited earnings potential. Cogent offers a full benefits package including; Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Paid Time Off (PTO) (20 days per year), Short and Long Term Disability, Life Insurance, Holidays, Family Leave (three weeks per year), 401(k) plan with employer match, stock options, and an Employee Assistance Program.

1/12 of one\-time NRCs (non\-recurring charges) \&
  
  

1/24 of Burst

jobs.description:
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue

  

**About the Role**
==================


We are looking for a customer\-focused, operationally minded leader to manage three Mid\-Market Customer Success Managers and lead our tech\-touch digital engagement strategy.


The ideal candidate is a strong coach with experience building scaled Customer Success programs. They are comfortable creating structure in ambiguous environments and have designed AI\-enabled workflows that improve customer engagement, team efficiency, or business outcomes. In this role, you'll:


* Manage, coach, and develop a team of three Mid\-Market CSMs
* Establish clear expectations, operating rhythms, and performance standards for a developing team
* Build and evolve our digital Customer Success motion across onboarding, adoption, engagement, and risk mitigation
* Use customer and product data to segment audiences and deliver the right mix of human and digital engagement
* Design and implement AI\-enabled workflows that improve efficiency, personalization, and proactive customer support
* Build scalable processes and measure their impact on customer health, adoption, retention, and team performance
* Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, and other teams to improve the customer experience
* Bring structure to ambiguity and turn ideas into repeatable programs

  

**Desired Capabilities**
========================

* 5 to 8 years of relevant experience, including a strong Customer Success background
* People leadership experience and a track record of coaching and developing CSMs
* Experience building or managing scaled, tech\-touch, or digital Customer Success programs
* Hands\-on experience designing or implementing AI\-enabled workflows
* Strong operational, analytical, and cross\-functional collaboration skills
* Comfort building new programs in an evolving environment

  

***Extra Credit***
==================

* Experience in HR or recruiting technology
* Experience partnering with Account Management or Sales on renewals, retention, and expansion

  

**Perks**
=========


Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life.

***The below benefits are for full\-time US employees.***


**Ownership:** Equity in a fast\-growing company


**Financial Wellness**: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching


**Family Support:** Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching


**Wellbeing:** Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend


**Growth:** $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development


**Remote \& Office:** Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office


**Time Off:** Flexible PTO, 15 holidays \+ 2 flex days


**Connection:** Team outings \& referral bonuses


Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers.


Compensation Range: $168K \- $210K

jobs.title: Manager 2, Data Science - Intuit Customer Success
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


The Intuit Customer Success (ICS) Data Science \& Analytics team is seeking an exceptional Manager 2, Data Science to lead measurement of expert\-driven service excellence across our CG expert workforce. You will lead a team of data scientists covering five interlocking areas: expert\-driven conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities (work item management, scheduling, and appointments), training efficacy and expert upskilling strategy, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization across our Team of Experts.

  

Collaborating closely with VEP (Virtual Expert Platform), Expert Network, and Service Design leaders, you will build the measurement backbone needed to see and optimize service excellence end\-to\-end (E2E) at scale for CG — with a particular focus on conversion and customer\-serving time outcomes. Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping the future of customer success at Intuit as we build a service platform to empower our customers beyond core product use. This is your opportunity to join this exciting and transformational journey.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own the measurement strategy across CG's expert service pillars — expert experiences conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities, training and upskilling, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization — in close partnership with VEP, Expert Network, and Service Design leaders.
* Advance causal inference and experimentation as a shared capability, establishing the causal relationship between service guidance, expert behavior, and outcomes like conversion and customer\-serving time.
* Contribute to a cross\-signal, causal\-graph decision engine that connects expert behavior, quality, and operational signals to size the impact of levers and inform roadmap and investment decisions.
* Build and govern the training and learning platform efficacy framework, connecting L\&D investment to expert quality and business outcomes.
* Partner with cross\-functional business leaders (e.g., VEP, Expert Network, Service Design, Service Delivery, Operations, Learning \& Development, Expert Engagement) to shape strategy, investment priorities, and reporting cadence (e.g., WBR, Redzone).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Deep understanding of the **MSP, MSSP, and Service Provider marketplace**, including industry trends, competitive dynamics, and partner business models.

* Experience working with SASE, Zero Trust, networking, or cybersecurity vendors.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Timberline Roofing Solutions is looking for an experienced, organized, and dependable Office Manager to help oversee the day\-to\-day operations of our roofing company.

This is a hands\-on position for someone who enjoys keeping an office organized, communicating with customers, coordinating schedules, handling administrative and bookkeeping tasks, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

At the end of the day, we are looking for someone who can take ownership of the office and become a key part of our team all while being a good person. This is a people first role. There's alot of phone calls and talking with team members and clients alike. If you do not think that fits your personaility this might not be the right fit.

**Duties**

* Manage incoming phone calls, emails, and customer inquiries
* Schedule roof inspections, repairs, and roofing projects
* Coordinate schedules between customers, office staff, and field crews
* Maintain organized customer and job records
* Prepare, edit, organize, and send estimates, reports, invoices, and other documents
* Assist with bookkeeping and day\-to\-day QuickBooks tasks
* Track invoices, customer payments, receipts, and outstanding balances
* Perform data entry and maintain accurate company records
* Work with Microsoft Word, PDFs, email, calendars, and other office software
* Help maintain an organized and efficient office
* Follow up with customers regarding appointments, estimates, projects, and payments
* Assist management with administrative and operational tasks as needed
* Help improve office systems and processes as the company continues to grow

**Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of previous office management, administrative management, or similar professional experience
* Quickbooks knowledge and experience in book keeping, tracking and receiving payments, batching etc.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Professional and confident phone communication
* Comfortable working with computers and learning new software
* Experience with Microsoft Word and PDF documents
* Ability to manage multiple jobs, customers, and priorities at the same time
* Strong attention to detail
* Dependable, professional, and able to work independently
* Spanish\-speaking/bilingual is a plus

The right person is someone who sees something that needs to be handled and takes care of it. You should be comfortable working in a busy office where priorities can change throughout the day.

You don't need to be a roofing expert when you start. We're looking for someone with strong office\-management fundamentals who can learn our business, understand our processes, and eventually know what's happening across inspections, repairs, roof replacements, scheduling, billing, and customer communication.

Why Timberline Roofing Solutions?

We're an established local roofing company serving residential and commercial customers throughout the Bay Area. We're focused on providing quality work and great customer service while continuing to improve and modernize how our company operates.

This position offers the opportunity to become an important part of that growth and have a meaningful impact on how our office operates every day.

Pay: $25\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Patient and Family Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
Patient \& Family Care Coordinator

**Part\-Time \| Tuesday–Thursday**  
**Flourish Airway Collective \| Danville, California**

Help children breathe, sleep, grow—and flourish.

Flourish Airway Collective is looking for an exceptionally warm, organized, and dependable person to become the welcoming heart of our practice.

This is not a traditional front\-desk position. Our Patient \& Family Care Coordinator will guide families through their Flourish experience—from the first phone call through treatment and follow\-up. The right person will genuinely love connecting with children and their parents, take pride in remembering the little details, and make every family feel seen, supported, and confident in their care.

At Flourish, we help infants, toddlers, children, and adolescents with concerns that may affect their breathing, sleep, feeding, speech, dental development, and overall well\-being. Our services include evaluation and treatment of tethered oral tissues, such as tongue\-ties and lip\-ties, as well as early orthodontic expansion to create more space for the teeth and tongue and support healthy airway development.

Our work can be life\-changing for children—and we want every family’s experience with us to feel just as exceptional as the care they receive.

**Who You Are**

You are naturally warm, reassuring, and wonderful with both children and adults. Parents feel comfortable asking you questions because you listen carefully, communicate clearly, and never make them feel rushed or dismissed.

You are also highly detail\-oriented. You notice what needs to be done, follow through without repeated reminders, and understand that small details matter—especially when families are navigating unfamiliar treatment.

You bring both heart and ownership to your work. You do not simply complete tasks; you make sure each family is truly taken care of.

**What You’ll DoCreate an Exceptional Family Experience**

* Warmly welcome children and parents when they arrive
* Help children feel comfortable, safe, and excited to visit Flourish
* Build genuine relationships with parents and caregivers
* Anticipate families’ needs and make each visit feel personal and organized
* Serve as a consistent, trusted point of contact throughout treatment
* Create thoughtful touches that make families feel especially cared for

**Communicate With Warmth and Confidence**

* Answer incoming phone calls with warmth, patience, and professionalism
* Listen carefully to parents’ questions and concerns
* Clearly explain what families can expect at upcoming appointments
* Become well trained in Flourish services, terminology, and treatment pathways
* Know when to answer a question, when to gather additional information, and when to involve a clinical team member
* Return calls, texts, and emails promptly and reliably
* Communicate in a way that is friendly, polished, compassionate, and easy to understand

**Coordinate Patient Care**

* Schedule consultations, treatment appointments, and follow\-up visits accurately
* Help families understand the next steps in their child’s care
* Confirm that required forms, records, photographs, referrals, and other information are received
* Track outstanding tasks and follow up until they are fully completed
* Coordinate communication with pediatricians, ENTs, myofunctional therapists, speech therapists, lactation consultants, and other collaborative providers
* Prepare and organize patient materials, referral information, and educational resources
* Help prevent families from getting lost between appointments or stages of care

**Support the Growth of Flourish**

* Maintain accurate, organized patient records and tracking systems
* Assist with correspondence, letters, reports, and follow\-up communication
* Help deliver educational materials or thoughtful packages to referring offices and community partners
* Support outreach efforts and relationships with local healthcare providers
* Look for ways to improve the family experience and practice systems
* Step in wherever needed to help Flourish run smoothly and beautifully

**What We’re Looking For**

* An exceptionally warm and welcoming personality
* A genuine love of children and appreciation for the parents who care for them

**About Ramp**
==============


Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================


Ramp builds software that moves real money, from bill payments and corporate cards to reimbursements, accounting integrations, and travel. Our customers rely on us to keep their operations running: invoices get paid, books get closed, and finance leaders can trust the data behind every decision.


In this role, you will be the person who spots where customers are getting stuck and drives issues to a clear resolution. You will learn a complex product deeply enough to troubleshoot across payments, bank linking, accounting syncs, and card programs, then partner with teams across Engineering, Risk, Product, and Partnerships to get problems solved. This is not script\-based support. You will triage, investigate, and make high\-signal judgment calls throughout the day.


You will thrive in this role if you are a systems thinker and deeply customer obsessed. Support is the baseline. How you think about improving processes, tools, and outcomes is what sets you apart.

  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Be the voice of Ramp's Customer Support.** You'll spend your day engaging with customers, primarily via live calls, email, and chat.
* **Diagnose across a broad product surface.** Ramp isn't one product — it's payments, cards, travel, accounting integrations, and more. You'll need to understand how they connect and where they break.
* **Operate with an ownership mindset, managing escalations end\-to\-end.** You take full accountability for every ticket you handle. When an issue crosses team boundaries — risk, engineering, product, partnerships — you route it correctly, follow up, and make sure the customer isn't left waiting. You'll work across Zendesk, internal tooling, and Slack\-based escalation workflows.
* **Build and shape AI tools, not just use them.** Ramp is building AI into CX operations. You'll use AI\-powered research tools and proprietary tools like Glass daily, provide direct feedback on what's working, and play an active role in how these tools evolve. You're not just a user — you're a builder. We are all builders at Ramp.
* **Ship improvements, not just flag them.** When you notice a process gap, a missing SOP, or a knowledge base article that's sending associates down the wrong path, you don't just raise it — you have the autonomy to roll up your sleeves and fix it. Leverage AI to solve problems, build automations, and improve the systems around you. The best people in this role make the whole team better.
* **Communicate with precision and empathy.** Our customers are financially sophisticated. You need to explain what's happening, what you're doing about it, and what they should expect — clearly and without filler.

**What You Need**
-----------------

* You're a systems thinker: you don't just solve the ticket in front of you, you ask why the problem exists and how to prevent it from happening again.
* You actively use AI tools — Claude, Notion AI, research and workflow tools — and can demonstrate how you've applied them to get real work done. This is a hard requirement.
* You're fast\-moving while holding yourself to a high bar for execution: you balance speed, accuracy, and thoroughness in every interaction.
* You can hold a technical conversation about how systems connect (APIs, bank integrations, accounting software) even if you're not writing code.
* You manage competing priorities without dropping things. When you have 15 open issues across 4 internal teams, nothing falls through.
* You write clearly and concisely. You can explain a payment reconciliation issue to a CFO without jargon.
* You're comfortable on the phone. Many interactions start there.
* You have a demonstrated track record of exceeding key performance standards, including CSAT, QA, and speed\-of\-service metrics.

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* Experience building workflows or automations using AI tools, not just prompting
* Familiarity with accounting workflows (AP/AR, GL, reconciliation) or ERP integrations (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage)
* Background in payments infrastructure (ACH, wire transfers, card networks)
* Track record of working somewhere that shipped product fast and expected CX to keep up

**Why be a CX Associate at Ramp**
---------------------------------

* **Cross\-functional exposure from day one.** You work directly with Product, Engineering, and GTM teams — not siloed into a support queue.
* **AI tools and unlimited access.** Unlimited tokens, proprietary AI tools like Glass, and a culture that expects you to use them to move faster and build smarter.
* **Career growth that you own.** Grow within CX, explore other functions internally, or carve out a path that doesn't exist yet. If you're invested, we're invested.
* **Culture that's different from a call center.** Team events, in\-person offsites, and a genuine commitment to building a team people want to be part of.

* Experience communicating complex concepts to internal and external audiences, and navigating high\-ambiguity technical challenges from concept to production deployment at a multi\-million or billion\-user scale.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


Google Search is dedicated to organizing the world’s information and making it universally accessible and useful. Maintaining user trust requires protecting Search from increasingly sophisticated adversarial threats. The proliferation of Generative AI, automated synthetic content networks, LLM\-driven parasite SEO, and agentic scraping has fundamentally transformed web spam from simple keyword manipulation into complex, automated adversarial campaigns.


As a Senior Product Manager for Google Search Anti\-Spam and Abuse, you will define and drive the multi\-year product strategy, technical architecture, and algorithmic defense mechanisms to combat AI\-driven abuse at a global scale. You will partner closely with Research Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Regulatory and Policy Experts, Anti\-Abuse experts, and Operations teams to ensure Search delivers high\-quality, authentic information.


In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

--------------------

* Define and drive the multi\-year product strategy, goal, and project roadmaps for combating spam and adversarial threats on Search, securing buy\-in from cross\-functional teams.
* Lead PRDs and collaborate with Engineering and Analyst partner teams to operationalize mechanisms that proactively detect abuse trends, combat spam, and manage incidents for deviations from expected system behavior.

Job details


Operations


San Francisco Bay Area


Full\-time


**About the role**


Azora is looking for an energetic, highly resourceful person to help keep a fast\-growing company organized and moving.


This is a broad, in\-person role spanning executive support, purchasing, travel, office organization, team logistics, recruiting coordination, and basic people operations. You will become the person the team relies on to solve practical problems quickly, coordinate the details behind important work, and make sure nothing gets lost between people, vendors, systems, and deadlines.


The right person thrives around people and activity. You enjoy tracking down hard\-to\-find equipment, untangling difficult travel schedules, organizing a busy office, helping new employees get started, and handling unexpected problems without waiting for someone to create a process first.


This is not a narrow administrative role or a predictable list of recurring tasks. Azora is growing quickly, and the work will change with it. There is substantial room to take on broader ownership of company operations as the team expands.


**What you’ll do**


* Provide executive and team support, including scheduling, calendar management, domestic and international travel coordination for employees, candidates, and company visitors, and organizing team events, dinners, off\-sites, and meeting logistics
* Keep the office organized, functional, stocked, and ready for employees, customers, and visitors.
* Own company purchasing, including office supplies, equipment, shipping, vendor coordination, and expense documentation.
* Coordinate interviews and support employee onboarding and offboarding, working with Azora’s PEO and external providers on payroll, benefits, documentation, and account setup.
* Help employees resolve routine operational questions and connect them with the right internal or external resource.
* Maintain company records, subscriptions, vendor information, insurance documents, and recurring administrative deadlines.
* Proactively keep CRM updated, maintaining up\-to\-date data on key contacts
* Track open operational tasks and follow up persistently until they are completed.
* Improve and document internal systems for purchasing, travel, onboarding, document management, and office operations as company scales
* Take ownership of special projects and unexpected problems that do not fit neatly within another person’s role.

### **Required Qualifications**


* Previous experience in company operations, office management, hospitality, recruiting coordination, executive administration, or a similarly demanding role.
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage many changing priorities without losing track of commitments.
* Resourcefulness and comfort completing unfamiliar tasks with limited direction.
* Strong judgment regarding urgency, confidentiality, cost, and when to escalate.
* Comfortable working in person and supporting a team that moves quickly.
* Able to interact naturally and professionally with engineers, candidates, vendors, customers, and external partners.
* Proficiency with modern productivity, travel, purchasing, and communication tools.

### **Preferred**


* Experience with purchasing – especially of highly technical equipment.
* Experience working in a startup or rapidly growing company.
* Experience with vendor management, employee onboarding, or office operations.
* Experience coordinating complex travel and company events.
* Interest in growing into broader responsibility for company operations.
* A genuine enjoyment of ambitious environments, unusual requests, and problems that initially appear impossible.

**Location \& arrangement**


This is a full\-time, in\-person role based in the Bay Area. Some travel may be required.


**Benefits:**


* Generous equity
* Competitive healthcare (including options for vision and dental)
* 401(k)
* Unlimited PTO

**EEO \& Reasonable Accommodations**


* *Azora is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*
* *If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know by contacting* *info@azora.space*

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicants must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (iii) protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\), or (iv) be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

* Final salary is based on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications.

**About this Company**


Azora is building high\-bandwidth communications infrastructure for environments where fiber can’t reach. This work spans LEO spacecraft constellations, lunar exploration missions, GEO satcom, deployable optical ground for defense, and data centers both on\- and off\-world. To enable rapid global proliferation Azora is developing compact and modular optical terminals small enough to deploy from a backpack, and space terminals that support high speed optical links from LEO out to the Moon.

jobs.title: Product Strategy and Operations Senior Associate, Executive and Strategic Engagements, Google for Education
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, or analytics in a technology company.

Experience working with and analyzing data.  
* 

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Advanced degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience managing multiple projects.
* Experience working with product and engineering teams.
* Experience with R, SQL, spreadsheets, or similar analytics tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.  

  

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross\-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.



In this role, you will help shape the future of education by joining the newly formed Central Strategy and Operations team within the Education Unit. You will partner with cross\-functional teams—including GTM, PgM, Data Science, PM, Engineering, and UXR—and collaborate across Product Areas to create a cohesive user experience across multiple surfaces and AI offerings. You will apply business excellence and strategic structure to drive forward one of Google’s highest\-priority initiatives.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $126000 \- $180000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Establish and manage the operational rhythm across GTM, Marketing, Communications, and Product teams. Facilitate alignment forums, monitor priority workstreams, and drive follow\-through on key strategic initiatives.
* Manage the end\-to\-end intake and triage framework for executive engagements. Evaluate requests against strategic criteria and produce executive summaries to guide resource allocation.
* Own and steward central stakeholder databases and tracking systems. Maintain data integrity, implement process improvements, and manage tooling integrations for scaled operations.
* Proactively streamline team operations and automate recurring workflows. Leverage AI tools to synthesize cross\-functional inputs, extract operational trends, and draft communications.
* Define and analyze operational health and engagement metrics. Translate trends into actionable recommendations that improve team efficiency and impact.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

.

The Senior Instructional Designer is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of world\-class programs for the Learning and Development team. This role will continuously improve learning programs using an array of creative approaches that drive productivity and innovation.


This role will consult and lead several projects for Learning and Development across departments with numerous stakeholders, subject matter experts and/or business partners, to create exceptional content focused on adult learning and business results. Must be an exceptional instructional designer, creative e\-learning expect and able to mentor other learning professionals.

**Summary**


The Senior Instructional Designer is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of world\-class programs for the Learning and Development team. This role will continuously improve learning programs using an array of creative approaches that drive productivity and innovation.

**Essential Functions**

* Design creative, innovative, and scalable programs for all levels using adult learning theories and methodologies (such as ADDIE, SAM, AGILE)
* Develop course materials that use an array of different media to produce materials that promote learning through self\-study, practice, performance support, and socialization and knowledge sharing
* Evaluate solutions and programs for quality, business impact, and scalability, leverage technology to extend access and provide just in time learning
* Produce training material(s) using rapid development tools and process

* Create user experience goals, priorities, and deliverables that align with product milestones, coordinate multiple projects to completion, and drive adoption of user experience practices
* Establish project plans and leads teams in the development of new learning content by managing completion of milestones and deliverables
* Leads others and participates in the design of curriculum, instruction, and assessment materials using knowledge of current trends and best practices in learning and development
* Lead and manage learning solution design, measurement strategy, and project management

* Facilitate engaging instructor\-led experiences effectively across a range of learners and content
* Evaluate impact and efficiency of training\- through formal and informal metrics— and identification of opportunities to inform work, refinements and strategy

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**

* Knowledgeable and functional in technical writing, including consistent and correct use of tense, grammar/spelling and terminology that is interesting and varied
* Knowledgeable of new learning approaches, technology and tools through continuous research
* Ability to collaborate on design and development projects as part of a team using consultative, and project management skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and maintain consistent delivery on commitments while working effectively in an environment that is constantly changing
* Ability to communicate difficult concepts and processes using clear and simple language and visuals with individuals, small groups and in front of large audiences at all levels of the organization
* Familiarity with mobile design guidelines for iOS and Android
* Ability to grasp the essence of complex design problems and user pain points, and translate them to practical design solutions
* Ability to accept and design against feedback from colleagues in a rapid iterative design process, and effectively produce multiple work products under tight timeline

**Education \& Experience / Licenses \& Certification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Curriculum Development, Education, Organizational Development or business required (Master’s Degree preferred) from an accredited college/university
* 5\+ years of experience as an instructional designer or Learning \& Development Program manager with demonstrated proficiency in designing, building and deploying instructor and e\-learning modules
* 5\+ years facilitating different corporate groups in workshop and/or training experiences
* Have a deep understanding of learning technologies including eLearning authoring tools and learning management systems
* Experience with multimedia and web design technologies including video conferencing/webinar technologies
* Advanced to intermediate experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, Google Apps, Microsoft Office Suite, Photo\-editing software, MS PowerPoint, Graphic Design software, Photoshop, Illustrator, Presentation

jobs.title: Senior Market Manager
jobs.description:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting\-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.


**Why Join Us?**

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.


We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time\-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.


**Senior Market Manager**

**Introduction to the Team**

Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services \- helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their partners.


From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.


**Make an Impact**

As a Senior Market Manager, you will manage and develop a segment of the portfolio to deepen partner relationships and grow accounts through strategic planning. You will act as a trusted advisor, take ownership of partner challenges, and coordinate internal and external solutions that deliver strong business outcomes. You may also lead negotiations for smaller accounts and share best practices across teams and regions.


**In this role, you will:**

* Establish and foster trusted relationships with key decision\-makers and influencers across partner accounts.
* Develop and manage dynamic local, regional, or chain\-level account plans based on partner needs, industry trends, account value, and likelihood of success.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen and grow accounts, including cross\-selling relevant products, services, and solutions.
* Lead partner discussions, progress reviews, fact\-finding meetings, and feedback sessions to understand needs and demonstrate the value of Expedia Group’s offerings.
* Apply knowledge of the partner’s business, industry, market dynamics, competitors, financial drivers, and operational complexity to anticipate needs and influence decisions.
* Identify business issues and potential solutions, assess costs, benefits, risks, and financial implications, and build a clear rationale for recommended action.
* Explain standard contracts and terms, partner with legal resources on appropriate terms for simple contracts, and seek senior support when negotiating complex or short\-term agreements.
* Replace simple or short\-term contracts with complex, multi\-year agreements where appropriate for the account or region.
* Travel to connect with partners face to face in assigned market (Bay Area)
* Align products, technology, and offerings to partner and market needs while maintaining a thorough working knowledge of Expedia Group’s portfolio and competitors’ strengths and weaknesses.
* Build productive relationships across the team, department, organization, and broader industry to support portfolio and organizational priorities.
* Represent Expedia Group at relevant industry events, support market or territory planning, and build the company’s profile in the assigned market where needed.
* Provide ongoing input to senior management on scalable solutions that improve process efficiency and partner outcomes.
**Experience and Qualifications**

* You have 5\+ years of relevant experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 3\+ years of relevant experience with a master’s degree.
* You have a bachelor’s or master’s degree, or equivalent related professional experience.
* You are proficient in English and, where applicable, the local language of the assigned market or markets.
* You are an impactful communicator who can present compelling rationales, influence stakeholders, handle objections, and move negotiations toward favorable outcomes.
* You apply effective sales techniques, including portfolio management, cross\-selling, account planning, and strategic relationship development.
* You have experience negotiating with director\- and C\-suite\-level stakeholders and managing operational complexity.
* You understand how to consider issues from another party’s perspective, identify common ground, and evaluate the costs and benefits of possible solutions .
* You understand the financial impact of decisions and how your role contributes to positive outcomes.
* You can build working knowledge of partner industries, market trends, economic challenges, competitive landscapes, products, technologies, and services.
The total cash range (inclusive of base salary and variable incentive target) for this position in San Francisco is $147,500\.00 to $206,500\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $236,000\.00, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Incentive plan performance above target will also earn more than the incentive target compensation amount.\&\#xa;  

  

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

jobs.description:
**About Us**



Fenix24 is an industry\-leading cyber disaster recovery and restoration company. Battling threat actors as The World’s First Civilian Cybersecurity Force, Fenix24 delivers cybersecurity services through its four battalions: Fenix24 for ransomware recovery and restoration; Athena7 for IT security assessments, strategy and planning; Grypho5 for ongoing security\-based management; and Argos99 for expert insights into data, assets and infrastructure. Under its Securitas Summa program, Fenix24 ensures organizations are prepared to effectively resist and rapidly recover from a cyberattack, offering a combination of managed data and infrastructure protection, real\-time threat intelligence, and ongoing hardening and breach resistance.

 **About This Position**



The Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a high\-impact individual contributor who supports Fenix24's priority customer relationships through technical expertise, proactive account management, and cross\-team coordination. Acting as a trusted advisor, the Senior TAM helps customers optimize their managed services experience across firewalls, backups, endpoint management, and platforms like Cohesity and Totango — working closely with engineering, NOC/SOC, and product teams to resolve complex issues and drive strong outcomes.

  



Success is measured by customer satisfaction, reduced technical friction, quality of solution guidance, escalation management, and contributions to scalable TAM practices.

 **Key Responsibilities**


* Own executive\-level relationships with CIOs, CISOs, and IT stakeholders; build multi\-year technical success plans; deliver QBRs/EBRs with data\-driven insights; advise on frameworks like NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and ISO 27001
* Serve as the escalation point for high\-severity or chronic issues; drive root cause analysis and preventive fixes; oversee complex onboarding/migrations (multi\-site firewalls, backup design, endpoint deployments); ensure configurations meet best practices and security standards
* Coordinate with SOC, NOC, engineering, CS Ops, and product on strategic initiatives; mentor junior TAMs; improve playbooks, escalation workflows, and communication standards; flag at\-risk accounts for retention efforts
* Build account health dashboards covering performance, risk, and usage trends; analyze contract value vs. consumption to spot churn or expansion opportunities; forecast client needs based on growth and threat trends
* Identify expansion opportunities (multi\-year agreements, broader firewall/endpoint deployments); support sales on renewals and executive presentations; act as SME on managed backups, firewalls, and endpoint security; contribute to webinars and client training

  


**Qualifications, Requirements \& Preferred Skills**


* 3–5 years in Technical Account Management, Managed Services, cybersecurity, or a similar customer\-facing technical role
* Track record managing mid\-to\-large enterprise accounts with complex technical/operational needs
* Strong expertise in managed firewalls/network security, backup platforms (Cohesity preferred), and endpoint security/management
* Experience with customer success platforms like Totango, including playbook use/implementation
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and cross\-functional collaboration skills (Engineering, NOC/SOC, Support, Product)
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including technical documentation and executive\-facing presentations
* Solid understanding of service delivery, SLAs, and managed services best practices

jobs.title: Health Coach
jobs.description:
About Alaya Health \& Wellness

Alaya Health \& Wellness is a functional, integrative, and longevity medicine practice focused on identifying and addressing the root causes of chronic symptoms and dysfunction. Our approach goes beyond symptom management by looking at the interconnected relationships between hormones, metabolism, gut health, inflammation, detoxification, nutrition, lifestyle, and cellular health.

Our patients often come to us after years of struggling with fatigue, hormone imbalance, weight resistance, digestive concerns, metabolic dysfunction, and other complex health concerns. We use comprehensive laboratory testing and individualized treatment plans to help patients understand what is happening in their bodies and create sustainable changes that support long\-term health.

We are growing our program\-based model of care and are looking for an experienced **Functional Medicine Health Coach** to become an important part of our patient care team.

The Position

The Functional Medicine Health Coach will work remotely with patients enrolled in Alaya Health \& Wellness programs. You will work collaboratively with our medical providers and nutrition team to help patients successfully implement their individualized plans of care.

This is not a position where you will be expected to diagnose, prescribe, or independently develop medical treatment plans. Your role is to help patients translate their provider\-directed plan into meaningful, sustainable changes in their everyday lives.

You will provide education, accountability, encouragement, and practical strategies around nutrition, exercise, sleep, stress management, behavior change, and other lifestyle factors that influence health and longevity.

Responsibilities

* Conduct scheduled telehealth coaching visits with patients enrolled in Alaya Health \& Wellness programs
* Help patients implement individualized nutrition, lifestyle, movement, sleep, and stress\-management recommendations
* Provide ongoing accountability and help patients identify barriers that may be preventing progress
* Reinforce treatment recommendations established by the medical provider
* Educate patients on foundational functional medicine principles and the interconnected nature of their health
* Support patients working through hormone optimization, metabolic health, gut health, detoxification, weight management, and longevity programs
* Review the patient's established care plan before coaching appointments and tailor coaching discussions accordingly
* Recognize when symptoms, questions, or concerns need to be escalated to the medical provider
* Document coaching visits clearly and promptly in the patient's medical record
* Communicate effectively with providers and other members of the Alaya care team
* Participate in occasional team meetings and case discussions
* Help create a supportive patient experience while maintaining appropriate professional and coaching boundaries

Ideal Candidate

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience in **functional, integrative, or lifestyle medicine**.

The ideal candidate understands that lasting health improvement requires more than simply telling patients what to eat. You should be comfortable discussing the relationships between nutrition, insulin resistance, metabolic health, sleep, stress physiology, movement, gut health, inflammation, hormone health, and healthy aging.

You should also be comfortable working with patients who may have complex histories and multiple health concerns.

Preferred Qualifications

* Certification or formal training in health and wellness coaching
* Functional medicine or integrative medicine training strongly preferred
* Previous experience working in a functional, integrative, hormone, or longevity medicine practice
* Experience providing virtual/telehealth health coaching
* Strong knowledge of nutrition, exercise, metabolic health, sleep, stress management, and behavior change
* Familiarity with BHRT, perimenopause/menopause, thyroid health, insulin resistance, GLP\-1 therapies, gut health, and detoxification is highly desirable
* Excellent communication and motivational interviewing skills
* Comfortable working collaboratively within a provider\-led treatment model
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple patients and follow\-up responsibilities independently
* Strong documentation skills
* Reliable internet connection and professional environment for telehealth visits

What We Are Looking For Personally

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping patients make meaningful changes—not someone who simply provides a checklist.

Our ideal coach is compassionate but able to hold patients accountable. You should be curious, organized, dependable, comfortable with complex cases, and passionate about functional and longevity medicine.

Most importantly, you should understand the philosophy behind root\-cause medicine and be excited to work as part of a collaborative team.

Position Details

* Fully remote position – candidates may be located anywhere in the United States
* Part\-time/hourly position with the potential for increased hours as our programs grow
* Patient visits conducted through telemedicine
* Compensation based on experience, training, and functional medicine background

**Hourly Rate:** $35/hour

To Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief cover letter answering the following:

* What functional or integrative medicine training or experience do you have?
* Have you previously coached patients in a medical or telehealth setting?
* What patient populations or areas of health are you most experienced in?
* What interests you about working with Alaya Health \& Wellness?
* What is your current weekly availability?

We are looking to fill this position quickly and will begin interviewing qualified candidates immediately.

Pay: $35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote
