new_jobs.description:
**About Us**



Fenix24 is an industry\-leading cyber disaster recovery and restoration company. Battling threat actors as The World’s First Civilian Cybersecurity Force, Fenix24 delivers cybersecurity services through its four battalions: Fenix24 for ransomware recovery and restoration; Athena7 for IT security assessments, strategy and planning; Grypho5 for ongoing security\-based management; and Argos99 for expert insights into data, assets and infrastructure. Under its Securitas Summa program, Fenix24 ensures organizations are prepared to effectively resist and rapidly recover from a cyberattack, offering a combination of managed data and infrastructure protection, real\-time threat intelligence, and ongoing hardening and breach resistance.

 **About This Position**



The Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a high\-impact individual contributor who supports Fenix24's priority customer relationships through technical expertise, proactive account management, and cross\-team coordination. Acting as a trusted advisor, the Senior TAM helps customers optimize their managed services experience across firewalls, backups, endpoint management, and platforms like Cohesity and Totango — working closely with engineering, NOC/SOC, and product teams to resolve complex issues and drive strong outcomes.

  



Success is measured by customer satisfaction, reduced technical friction, quality of solution guidance, escalation management, and contributions to scalable TAM practices.

 **Key Responsibilities**


* Own executive\-level relationships with CIOs, CISOs, and IT stakeholders; build multi\-year technical success plans; deliver QBRs/EBRs with data\-driven insights; advise on frameworks like NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and ISO 27001
* Serve as the escalation point for high\-severity or chronic issues; drive root cause analysis and preventive fixes; oversee complex onboarding/migrations (multi\-site firewalls, backup design, endpoint deployments); ensure configurations meet best practices and security standards
* Coordinate with SOC, NOC, engineering, CS Ops, and product on strategic initiatives; mentor junior TAMs; improve playbooks, escalation workflows, and communication standards; flag at\-risk accounts for retention efforts
* Build account health dashboards covering performance, risk, and usage trends; analyze contract value vs. consumption to spot churn or expansion opportunities; forecast client needs based on growth and threat trends
* Identify expansion opportunities (multi\-year agreements, broader firewall/endpoint deployments); support sales on renewals and executive presentations; act as SME on managed backups, firewalls, and endpoint security; contribute to webinars and client training

  


**Qualifications, Requirements \& Preferred Skills**


* 3–5 years in Technical Account Management, Managed Services, cybersecurity, or a similar customer\-facing technical role
* Track record managing mid\-to\-large enterprise accounts with complex technical/operational needs
* Strong expertise in managed firewalls/network security, backup platforms (Cohesity preferred), and endpoint security/management
* Experience with customer success platforms like Totango, including playbook use/implementation
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and cross\-functional collaboration skills (Engineering, NOC/SOC, Support, Product)
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including technical documentation and executive\-facing presentations
* Solid understanding of service delivery, SLAs, and managed services best practices

new_jobs.title: Health Coach
new_jobs.description:
About Alaya Health \& Wellness

Alaya Health \& Wellness is a functional, integrative, and longevity medicine practice focused on identifying and addressing the root causes of chronic symptoms and dysfunction. Our approach goes beyond symptom management by looking at the interconnected relationships between hormones, metabolism, gut health, inflammation, detoxification, nutrition, lifestyle, and cellular health.

Our patients often come to us after years of struggling with fatigue, hormone imbalance, weight resistance, digestive concerns, metabolic dysfunction, and other complex health concerns. We use comprehensive laboratory testing and individualized treatment plans to help patients understand what is happening in their bodies and create sustainable changes that support long\-term health.

We are growing our program\-based model of care and are looking for an experienced **Functional Medicine Health Coach** to become an important part of our patient care team.

The Position

The Functional Medicine Health Coach will work remotely with patients enrolled in Alaya Health \& Wellness programs. You will work collaboratively with our medical providers and nutrition team to help patients successfully implement their individualized plans of care.

This is not a position where you will be expected to diagnose, prescribe, or independently develop medical treatment plans. Your role is to help patients translate their provider\-directed plan into meaningful, sustainable changes in their everyday lives.

You will provide education, accountability, encouragement, and practical strategies around nutrition, exercise, sleep, stress management, behavior change, and other lifestyle factors that influence health and longevity.

Responsibilities

* Conduct scheduled telehealth coaching visits with patients enrolled in Alaya Health \& Wellness programs
* Help patients implement individualized nutrition, lifestyle, movement, sleep, and stress\-management recommendations
* Provide ongoing accountability and help patients identify barriers that may be preventing progress
* Reinforce treatment recommendations established by the medical provider
* Educate patients on foundational functional medicine principles and the interconnected nature of their health
* Support patients working through hormone optimization, metabolic health, gut health, detoxification, weight management, and longevity programs
* Review the patient's established care plan before coaching appointments and tailor coaching discussions accordingly
* Recognize when symptoms, questions, or concerns need to be escalated to the medical provider
* Document coaching visits clearly and promptly in the patient's medical record
* Communicate effectively with providers and other members of the Alaya care team
* Participate in occasional team meetings and case discussions
* Help create a supportive patient experience while maintaining appropriate professional and coaching boundaries

Ideal Candidate

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience in **functional, integrative, or lifestyle medicine**.

The ideal candidate understands that lasting health improvement requires more than simply telling patients what to eat. You should be comfortable discussing the relationships between nutrition, insulin resistance, metabolic health, sleep, stress physiology, movement, gut health, inflammation, hormone health, and healthy aging.

You should also be comfortable working with patients who may have complex histories and multiple health concerns.

Preferred Qualifications

* Certification or formal training in health and wellness coaching
* Functional medicine or integrative medicine training strongly preferred
* Previous experience working in a functional, integrative, hormone, or longevity medicine practice
* Experience providing virtual/telehealth health coaching
* Strong knowledge of nutrition, exercise, metabolic health, sleep, stress management, and behavior change
* Familiarity with BHRT, perimenopause/menopause, thyroid health, insulin resistance, GLP\-1 therapies, gut health, and detoxification is highly desirable
* Excellent communication and motivational interviewing skills
* Comfortable working collaboratively within a provider\-led treatment model
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple patients and follow\-up responsibilities independently
* Strong documentation skills
* Reliable internet connection and professional environment for telehealth visits

What We Are Looking For Personally

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping patients make meaningful changes—not someone who simply provides a checklist.

Our ideal coach is compassionate but able to hold patients accountable. You should be curious, organized, dependable, comfortable with complex cases, and passionate about functional and longevity medicine.

Most importantly, you should understand the philosophy behind root\-cause medicine and be excited to work as part of a collaborative team.

Position Details

* Fully remote position – candidates may be located anywhere in the United States
* Part\-time/hourly position with the potential for increased hours as our programs grow
* Patient visits conducted through telemedicine
* Compensation based on experience, training, and functional medicine background

**Hourly Rate:** $35/hour

To Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief cover letter answering the following:

* What functional or integrative medicine training or experience do you have?
* Have you previously coached patients in a medical or telehealth setting?
* What patient populations or areas of health are you most experienced in?
* What interests you about working with Alaya Health \& Wellness?
* What is your current weekly availability?

We are looking to fill this position quickly and will begin interviewing qualified candidates immediately.

Pay: $35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------



Join the Lockheed Martin Production Operations One Lockheed Martin Transformation (1LMX) Plan to Stock (PTS) Information Technology (IT) team as an IT Business Analyst (ITBA) supporting the SAP S/4HANA Product Compliance and Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) modules.


Applies functional knowledge to the design, system integration, and configuration for critical compliance and sustainability processes, ensuring adherence to global regulations, accurate product stewardship, and comprehensive employee safety and environmental management within our SAP S/4HANA ecosystem.


The successful candidate will apply strong SAP functional expertise and regulatory knowledge to align Product Compliance and EHS processes across the enterprise. They will partner closely with business process owners, legal teams, developers, and system architects to design, configure, and implement solutions that mitigate risk, ensure compliance, and support Lockheed Martin's sustainability goals.


This position is fully remote.

**Responsibilities**


The IT Business Analyst will be a key leader in solution delivery, driving the successful design and implementation of SAP Product Compliance and EHS capabilities. Core responsibilities include:

* **Lead and Drive Functional Design:** Analyze complex global regulatory requirements and internal safety standards, leading functional design sessions to translate them into effective, integrated processes within SAP S/4HANA.
* **Solution Configuration and Documentation:** Be **accountable** for performing system configuration and executing Component Unit Testing (CUT) within the SAP Product Compliance and EHS modules. Ensure accurate configuration documentation (KCDs) is created and maintained.
* **Own Specifications and Testing Data:** Take ownership of **authoring Functional Specifications (FRICE)** for all enhancements and integrations. Furthermore, be **responsible** for creating and preparing necessary test data for both Component Unit Testing (CUT) and Functional Unit Testing (FUT).
* **Coordinate Testing Cycles:** Execute Functional Unit Testing (FUT) and actively support business process owners during Integration Testing Cycles (ITC) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including identifying appropriate test data and resolving issues.
* **System and Process Guidance:** Serve as the functional expert, providing authoritative guidance on system best practices, optimal configuration, and process design for regulatory and safety compliance.
* **Manage Development Collaboration:** Collaborate closely with ABAP developers and technical teams to author and review technical specifications, ensuring that standardized, scalable, and technically compliant solutions are built.
* **Ensure Regulatory and Technical Adherence:** Coordinate with internal teams to ensure all designed solutions adhere to both Lockheed Martin's business standards and technical requirements.
* **Support Readiness and Deployment:** Prepare comprehensive documentation and training materials, support final data validation, and manage production readiness activities for all Product Compliance and EHS deployments.
* **Improvement and Backlog Management:** Identify opportunities for process improvement, recommend SAP innovations to increase efficiency and compliance, and utilize Jira and SAP Focused Build to manage backlogs and requirements throughout the Agile lifecycle.
**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------


* Experience authoring functional specifications based on business requirements and translating them into technical design deliverables.
* Experience collaborating with ABAP developers and technical teams to design and standardize integrated functional solutions.
* Ability to analyze compliance and safety data, identify process gaps, and facilitate data\-driven decisions that improve risk management.
* Experience supporting end\-to\-end system implementation including requirements gathering, blueprinting, development, testing, and go\-live.
* Demonstrated problem\-solving and analytical skills involving the integration of multiple IT systems and regulatory content feeds.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills with the ability to translate between technical, functional, and legal/regulatory audiences.
* U.S. Citizenship required, as this role supports systems related to national defense.
**Desired Skills**
------------------


* **Hands\-on configuration experience** with:
* **SAP S/4HANA Product Compliance** (especially Dangerous Goods, Product Marketability and Compliance, and SDS Management).
* **SAP S/4HANA EHS** (especially Incident Management, Risk Assessment, and Environmental Management).
* Familiarity with the integration points between Product Compliance/EHS and other core SAP modules (e.g., Materials Management (MM), Production Planning (PP), Sales and Distribution (SD)).
* Strong functional understanding of regulatory requirements (e.g., REACH, RoHS, GHS/CLP, OSHA) and how they are mapped into SAP compliance and EHS modules.
* Experience with **regulatory content integration** (e.g., utilizing services from external content providers).
* Understanding of **Substance Volume Tracking (SVT)** and management of chemical inventories.
* Experience with **data validation** and master data dependencies for compliance objects (e.g., specifications, listed substances).
* Experience using **Jira** and **SAP Focused Build** to manage backlogs, requirements, and testing.
* Ability to independently lead design and testing across integrated regulatory and safety systems.
* Experience in Agile or hybrid ERP delivery environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for both business and technical stakeholders.
